sections.heading: Evidence Grade B
sections.body: The signed packet is grade B: 54 listing reviews, high specificity in several transcribed reviews, a first-party owner post, and an unresolved phone conflict. This packet is a signed subset of listing text. Missing reviews were not invented. Silicone and metal restoration stay labeled as owner-post claims.

sections.heading: What Joplin Neighbors Report
sections.body: Google lists Kingdom Roofing and Construction at 5.0 from 54 reviews. Here is what named customers wrote about the work.
bullets: Randy Coleman: "After waiting on my roofer I've had for years I called Eric. He got back with me the same day not only with a phone call but an estimate. Within a week the roof was on. I now have a new roofer! The price was reasonable and the service was exceptional, including trimming back some tree that over time would have caused damage to the new roof! I recommend Eric and his company 5 stars!"

Val Packard: "If you're looking for an honest roofing company, I highly recommend Kingdom Roofing. Eric came out quickly to inspect everything and was professional, efficient, and incredibly knowledgeable… he wasn't looking to sell me something I didn't need and was upfront that repairs weren't necessary."

Juell Brandt: "My mobile home has had a leaky roof since we got it in 2020… Kingdom Roofing came up from Joplin and gave me a very good solution & quote, much cheaper than having a second roof put on… No leaks, sound-proof!"
Carterville First Baptist Church: "Kingdom Roofing responded immediately to my request for a quote on my roof. Most other roofing companies wouldn't even show up… The best part, no more leaks!"
